substrate.reason: facade crate: depends on substrate-app, so it sits above the application slice it re-exports

sharecli-core.reason: facade crate: aggregates sharecli-ipc and sharecli-fuse; the -core name is misleading

agileplus-cache.reason: read cache over agileplus-domain; infrastructure, and nothing in the workspace consumes it

agileplus-events.reason: event transport for the agileplus slice; infrastructure, no consumers yet

agileplus-git.reason: git adapter for agileplus-domain; no consumers yet

agileplus-import.reason: import adapter writing into agileplus-domain; no consumers yet

agileplus-triage.reason: triage domain service; agileplus-github consumes it, so it cannot sit below L3 without an upward edge

agileplus-github.reason: GitHub adapter, but it depends on agileplus-triage (L3), so R2 forces L3 over the L2 a -github name implies

eidolon-desktop.reason: desktop product surface over eidolon-core; shipping app, not a library other crates link

eidolon-mobile.reason: mobile product surface; ships three binaries

eidolon-sandbox.reason: sandboxed runtime product; ships four binaries

fabric-persist.reason: persistence adapter beside the store-* family; four L4 consumers (daemon, gui, orchestrator, tui)

fabric-surface-mojo.reason: Mojo binding of the fabric surface; consumed by fabric-orchestrator, so it sits just below the app slice

fabric-workspace.reason: workspace service over fabric-capability and fabric-graph; consumed by fabric-orchestrator

focus-always-on.reason: always-on runtime service with no binary of its own, so it is a service layer, not an app

focus-penalties.reason: domain rule set consumed by focus-rituals (L3)

focus-policy.reason: policy engine sitting on focus-rules; no name rule and no consumers to place it

focus-rewards.reason: domain rule set consumed by focus-rituals (L3)

focus-rituals.reason: ritual orchestration over focus-penalties, focus-rewards and focus-scheduler

focus-rules.reason: rules engine over focus-domain with two L3 consumers (focus-policy, focus-templates)

llm-router.reason: routing service over omniroute-adapter and substrate-core; no consumers yet

substrate-browser-provider.reason: browser provider adapter over substrate-browser; infrastructure with no consumers yet

substrate-memory.reason: memory store beside store-sqlite, which it depends on

supervisor.reason: process supervisor consumed by wave (L3), so it belongs at the same service altitude

wave.reason: wave runtime over supervisor and store-sqlite; consumed by dispatch-bridge (L4)

worktree-manager.reason: ships a worktree-manager binary, so it is a tool rather than a library
